Integrate with mail through an explicit contract

The metadata explorer documents the public mail entities and endpoints. It gives automation and administration clients a supported way to inspect messages, recipients, attachments and templates without depending on the delivery implementation.

Use it when building operational tooling or integrations around the mail queue.
